name: Frozen cross-dataset token-group contribution replication
hypothesis: The unchanged regional selector ranks useful memory evidence across datasets: removing rejected-enriched groups harms segmentation less than count/geometry/age-matched retained-enriched and random groups.
scope: Exploratory DAVIS 2017 validation transfer diagnostic. This split has already been used in project development. Neither independent held-out confirmation nor a claim that foundation pretraining excluded these videos. Counterfactuals condition on fixed native histories; no treatment writes memory and no autoregressive method efficacy claim.

sam2.reuse: Original native frame schedule, mask encoder/decoder, pointers, first-frame prompting, indexed mask I/O and non-overlap output resolution.

efficient_sam2.reuse: Unchanged pinned first-read attention importance, top-k and sparse K/V gathering with original RoPE coordinates, exactly as Run171.

lean_sam2.reuse: Unchanged pinned prompt appearance anchors, maximum cosine matching, score preparation and multiplicative fusion, exactly as Run171. Not a full-system reproduction.

official_davis_evaluator.reuse: Unmodified semi-supervised DAVISEvaluation.evaluate(J,F); first and last frames excluded. Pinned API converts void GT to background in this path; audited data contain zero void-labelled frames. Supplementary Dice excludes void explicitly.

model.device: CPU FP32, two threads, deterministic algorithms; native stored-memory dtype retained
model.memory: Prompt plus up to six recent past frames; current frame supplies queries. Native pointer tail and original coordinates remain intact.
model.no_added_gates_or_thresholds: No confidence decision, frame quality selection, learned adapter or training. Native SAM2 object-presence and binary output rules remain unchanged.

data.first_frame_prompts: Persistent indexed IDs, every prompted instance separately, no later annotation enters inference or selection. Later GT only scores and freezes uniformly sampled analysis targets.
data.all_inputs_sha256: design/preflight.json records every input image and mask; checked before and after each video.
data.no_outcome_selection: Run all 30 videos after engineering passes, irrespective of effect direction.

selector_and_groups.native_trajectory: Retain all keys. Compute causal per-layer first-read importance and soft own-stored-mask prompt-anchor affinity p*sf+(1-p)*sb. Cache top25% selector disposition, not a pruned native state.
selector_and_groups.instances: Each persistent ID has its own masks, attention usage and foreground/context prompt anchors; no global foreground union. Context can contain another object, following the unchanged one-versus-rest selector.
selector_and_groups.group: 64x64 grid, disjoint 4x4-token blocks. Remove 16 blocks=256 tokens per older frame per layer. Protect prompt, latest frame and pointers. Rejected/retained rank block membership in selector top25%; random matches block count, size and source age, not global connectivity.
selector_and_groups.split: A/B remove 8 blocks=128 tokens, exact disjoint halves of rejected union.
selector_and_groups.seed_context: Unchanged layer|source_frame|video. Random positions may correlate across instances; video is the unit. No extra seeds, width/budget changes or outcome-driven tuning.

conditions.full_coverage_detail: Export complete indexed predictions for every video/frame. On each official scored frame, replay each object and merge outputs through native non-overlap resolution. Initial frames with no eligible older memory naturally have no deletion; first/last exports reuse native outputs.
conditions.split_targets: Union across object-specific four uniformly spaced GT-present plus up to two GT-absent targets, local frame>=3 and <last. The full frozen plan is in preflight. At union frames, apply A/B to every prompted object before native overlap resolution. No full official A/B benchmark score; only sampled interaction analysis.
conditions.history: All arms use the same native history; private replay clones cannot call the memory encoder or write state.

engineering.fixture: DAVIS training bmx-bumps first8 frames, two persistent IDs. All variants use fresh models and native mask prompts.
required: Exact native collector parity for raw per-object masks, object scores, pointers, memory features and joint full-resolution logits against an independent uninstrumented run.
Exact private all-key replay for masks, pointers and object scores; all four layers, identical memory-frame/position/pointer input hashes and own stored-mask lineage.
Joint, reverse-registration and each-object-alone runs give identical raw per-ID outputs and selector cache signatures.
Asymmetric intervention on one ID leaves other raw output and caches untouched. Final overlap-resolved visible masks may change normally.
Matched main budgets and protected prompt/latest/pointers; deterministic repeat random replay; no bank, feature-cache, selector-cache or foundation-weight mutation.
Author indexed export and official evaluation exercised on the eight-frame engineering fixture, explicitly not reported as benchmark performance.
engineering.cohort_baseline: Every validation frame must reproduce archived Run161 native full-logit hashes and indexed mask pixels under the identical checkpoint/config/author source. Validate all archived PNG checksums and receipts before inference.
engineering.failure: Stop at integrity failure. Preserve failed attempt and diagnose; never bypass assertions. Scientific settings do not change because results are unexpected.

statistics.unit: Video. Average frames within object, objects within video, videos equally for inferential comparisons. Official leaderboard global scores additionally average over all61 objects.
co_primary_endpoints: Uniformly sampled present Dice, matching Run171 target scheme
statistics.multiplicity: Two endpoints x two contrasts = four two-sided paired Wilcoxon tests, Holm adjustment across four.
statistics.intervals: Paired video bootstrap,10000 resamples,seed20261107. Report all videos, wins/ties/losses, leave-one-video-out mean effects.
secondary: Sampled empty false-alarm counts with denominators
Split-group U(AB)-U(A)-U(B)=DiceA+DiceB-DiceAB-DiceNative, averaged over matched sampled present objects/videos
Removed-block descriptors, cached first-read attention share, predicted occupancy and vector norm
statistics.decision: Ranking discrimination signal requires complete30-video cohort and positive lower bootstrap bound plus majority video wins on all four co-primary contrasts. Report Holm p-values. A positive diagnostic is not an efficacy gain; a negative one stops this selector, without tuning or reversing it.
statistics.cross_dataset: Compare signs and uncertainty with fixed Run171 PolypGen contrasts. Dataset scores are not numerically interchangeable; evidence concerns whether selector utility ordering transfers. No pooled frame-level significance or paper-score substitution.

storage_and_tracking.destination: Mounted Google Drive outputs/experiment/172_davis_token_contribution_v1; outputs, runtime staging and logs remain there. No local result copy.
storage_and_tracking.freeze: Commit this protocol, instance adapter, runner and tests before any model inference; snapshot/hash imported sources, inputs, checkpoint and reference outputs.
progress: per-video completion.json and compressed per-object/arm records
storage_and_tracking.cloud: Mount writes alone do not prove remote sync. Do not use the currently connected wrong-account Drive connector.

later_mose_assessment.finding: Author repository inspected. Public MOSEv2 training split has dense annotations; validation supplies only first-frame masks. A local utility diagnostic requires a separately reserved densely annotated training subset, clearly not official validation. No MOSE inference is launched in this protocol.

later_mose_assessment.excluded: Do not import the MOSE repository SAM2 confidence/memory-selection baseline into this frozen replication.
